# Supplied astronaut artwork

| In-game view | Supplied file | Local source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Down / front | Pixel Astronaut Walking Sprite Set.svg | walk-set.svg |
| Right | Pixel Astronaut Walking Cycle.svg | walk-cycle.svg |
| Left | Pixel Astronaut Walking Frames.svg | walk-frames.svg |
| Up / back | Pixel Astronaut Walking Sprite Sheet.svg | walk-sheet.svg |
| Front idle | Pixel Art Chibi Astronaut Sprite.svg | idle.svg |

`frames/` contains four native SVG frames per walking direction plus `idle.svg`, cropped from these sources. Detached vector tracing specks were omitted. The solid white page backdrop in the right-facing source was removed while preserving the suit's white artwork. All frames use a transparent 128×160 viewport and a consistent ground anchor.

The originals in Downloads were left unchanged. Artwork supplied by the user; no new character artwork was generated.
